nativeBehavior.password: Four-digit PIN entered twice to enable; matching stored PIN required to disable. Native state is local AppSetting, not a cloud account setting.
nativeBehavior.logout: sug.enable calls h99.ޅ/m9056, clears current in-memory identity and removes uid/username/token/avatar/admin/push/level/userType from native preferences.
nativeBehavior.clock: Process foreground elapsed usage, local calendar day reset, 40 minute limit, local hour allowed interval [06:00,22:00). The native periodic check uses accumulated time >40 minutes; desktop enforces the stated quota at exactly 40 minutes.

desktopBehavior.store: Main-only clock and activity events; atomic persisted record; salted scrypt verifier; optional Windows safeStorage encryption for the complete record; no raw PIN in snapshot or disk; failed checkpoint/corrupt record fails closed.
desktopBehavior.password: Four numeric characters, matching confirmation, correct old PIN for change/exit. Five failed attempts lock verification for 30 seconds, persisted across restart. Concurrent mutations serialize.
desktopBehavior.screen: Dedicated curated renderer with plain text and allowlisted Coolapk CDN images. No login, publish, replies, search, social actions or external rich links. Blocked/day transitions discard pending content/detail results.
desktopBehavior.integration: Root owns pre-App mode loading, guest-only fixed V12_TEENAGER API, source-authorized feed IDs, epoch guards and central IPC restrictions for normal API/accounts/login/import/phone/report/export/external actions. Main integration is verified separately from this agent's store and renderer tests.
